items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: We left there and went out on the road with a show called Atlantic City Follies. That was with Peg Leg Bates and Marva Louis... We traveled all over with her, with that show.

ctx.x: Then up in Atlantic City for two years.

No, not quite two years. I stayed up there with him all that year, and then I left... We left there and went out on the road with a show called Atlantic City Follies. That was with Peg Leg Bates and Marva Louis, Joe Louis' wife -
